description:
Patch a stored post. ``patch`` may set ``doc, publish_at, recurrence,
cease_at, status`` (omit a field to leave it unchanged). ``text_cache`` is
written when supplied (alongside a doc change). ``client_req_id`` dedupes
debounced autosave retries — a repeat is a no-op with no second charge.

client_req_id.description:
Idempotency key for this edit; resending the last applied
id changes nothing and charges nothing.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

patch.description:
Object of the fields to change, any of ``doc``, ``publish_at``,
``recurrence``, ``cease_at``, ``status`` (``draft``, ``scheduled``,
``archived``, ``sent``), ``tweet_url``, ``title``. Each value has
the same shape ``create_post`` takes.

text_cache.description:
Composed text (blocks joined) to store with a ``doc``
change; blank leaves the stored text as it is.

name: excalibur_update_post
title: Update a post
